question: largest building footprints lisbon sqm
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, subtype, ROUND(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry), 1) AS area_m2 FROM lisbon_buildings ORDER BY area_m2 DESC LIMIT 10

question: road network length km per class
sql: SELECT class, ROUND(SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000.0, 2) AS length_km FROM lisbon_roads GROUP BY class ORDER BY length_km DESC

question: total sidewalk length m
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(ST_Length(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true))), 1) AS sidewalk_length_m FROM lisbon_roads WHERE subclass = 'sidewalk'

question: school buildings perimeter m
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, ROUND(ST_Perimeter(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true)), 1) AS perimeter_m FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE class = 'school' ORDER BY perimeter_m DESC

question: length of Passeio Marítimo de Algés in metres
sql: SELECT names.primary AS name, ROUND(SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)), 1) AS length_m FROM lisbon_roads WHERE names.primary = 'Passeio Marítimo de Algés' GROUP BY names.primary

question: outline of buildings over 500 sq m
sql: SELECT id, names.primary AS name, ROUND(ST_Area(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true)), 1) AS area_m2, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE ST_Area(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true)) > 500 ORDER BY area_m2 DESC LIMIT 20
